title: Aikatsu Stars 10th Anniversary Film's Trailer Unveils Theme Song, January 22 Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Pictures presented the full trailer and a key visual for Aikatsu Stars! Hoshiboshi no Progress (The Progress of the Stars), the film celebrating the 10th anniversary of the Aikatsu Stars! anime, during a fan meeting event for the film on Saturday. The trailer announces the film's January 22 opening, and it also previews the main theme song "Five stars." Sena, Rie, Miki, Nanase, and Kana perform both this song and the ending theme song "Anata e" (To You).

The tagline of the film is, "Our (rainbow-colored) dream isn't over yet."

The film begins just before the graduation of Yume and the others, when they receive an invitation from Neo Venus Ark's Elza to perform in the "Venus Jamboree" event among the world's top idols. A mysterious passenger ship, the Petit Venus Ark , appears before them.

The Aikatsu Stars! anime series director Teruo Sato returns to direct the new film at Bandai Namco Pictures . Original series head writer Yūko Kakihara is also back to write the film's scenario. The original series' character designer Yukiko Aikei performs the same role for the film. Bandai Namco Pictures is distributing the film.

The Aikatsu Stars! television anime series debuted on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels in April 2016, and ended in March 2018 with 100 episodes. The first Aikatsu Stars! anime film opened in August 2016.

Aikatsu Stars! was followed in the franchise by the Aikatsu Friends! anime from April 2018 to September 2019, the Aikatsu on Parade! anime from October 2019 to July 2020, the hybrid anime/live-action series Aikatsu! Planet in January to June 2021, and finally the franchise 's first foray into a YouTube -exclusive VTuber project with Aikatsu! Academy! in July 2024. Aikatsu! Planet also got an anime film in July 2022.

The Aikatsu! franchise began with the original arcade card game in October 2012. The game inspired a television anime that ran from 2012 to 2016, and three anime films. Each of the successive anime installments of the franchise had their own associated arcade card game ( Aikatsu! Academy! , as a YouTube -exclusive project, has no associated anime and arcade card game).

The Aikatsu! 10th Story ~Mirai e no Starway~ (Starway to the Future) anime film is the overall franchise 's 10th anniversary film, and it opened in Japan in January 2023. The brand-new story for the original Aikatsu! series reunites that series' director Ryuichi Kimura , scenario writer Yoichi Kato , and character designer Hiroko Yaguchi . The project is set in the story of the 2012 to 2016 Aikatsu! anime, and centers once again on protagonist Ichigo Hoshinomiya.

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams Story Trailer for 1st Act 'Kokura'
content:
Sega began streaming a story trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video outlines the game's first act "Kokura," and "depicts the events that led Daito, who had endured persecution in America, to stow away on the 'ghost ship' of the merchant Orpheus in pursuit of Japan."

The game will explore different times and places in Japan's modern history, including Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; Minami, Osaka in 1943; Atami, Shizuoka in 1951; and the fictional neighborhood of Kamurocho (based on the Kabukicho neighborhood, and a constant setting of RGG Studio's Yakuza/Like a Dragon games) in Shinjuku, Tokyo in 1965.

Sega describes the game's story:

A 50-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. In 1915 San Francisco, a young boy, Makoto Daito, sneaks aboard a suspicious ship in the harbor under the cover of night. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto faces harsh persecution due to his Asian heritage. After losing both of his parents, Makoto decides to travel to his mother's homeland, Japan, where a fateful encounter awaits. With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life.

The cast includes:

• Yū Shirota as Makoto Daito

• Snoop Dogg as Orpheus

• Moeka Hoshi as Tae Matsumoto

• Tori Kelly as Suzy Day

• Akio Ōtsuka as Heigo Yashima

• Tokuma Nishioka as Kiyoshi Otsuru

• Satoshi Fujihara as Takashi

• Cordell Broadus as The Veiled Stranger

• Ado as Keiko Shirai

• Bunta Sugawara (model basis) and Takashi Ukaji (voice) as Genzo Iwaki

• Late American rapper Tupac

• Takaya Kuroda (who plays Kazuma Kiryu in Ryu ga Gotoku's related Yakuza/Like a Dragon series)

• Kouhei Tsuji

• Yasukaze Motomiya (who plays Kosei Shishido in the Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name game and Kazuma Kiryu in Nihon Tohitsu's live-action Like a Dragon Powered By Nihon Touitsu series)

Sega provided the following comment regarding the character Genzo Iwaki and the model for the character being based on the late actor Bunta Sugawara :

In STRANGER THAN HEAVEN , the late and legendary actor Bunta Sugawara appears. SEGA received formal consent from his family, and, with materials provided by Toei Company Ltd. —which produced many of Mr. Sugawara's films, including the Battles Without Honor and Humanity — RGG Studio crafted his CG character design based on archival footage and photographs from the time.

Snoop Dogg , Satoshi Fujihara , Ado, and Tori Kelly perform the game's theme song "Stranger Than Heaven." The song will get a release this year.

The game is inspiring a live-action film on Netflix .

Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties , Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's remake of the Yakuza 3 game along with the new standalone Dark Ties title, launched as a single release for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam worldwide on February 12.

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Streams 'Last' Promo Video
content:
The official YouTube channel for the Bleach franchise began streaming on Friday "the last" promotional video for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime.

The Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime has been running for four cours (quarter of a year) with breaks in between.

The anime covers the rest of the original manga up through its ending. The Thousand Year Blood War arc is the final arc of the manga, and covers volumes 55-74.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity debuted on July 25 on the TV Tokyo channel at 11:00 p.m. JST (10:00 a.m. EDT). The anime began streaming on Japanese streaming services on July 26 at noon.

jo0ji performs the opening theme song "I-BULL" and singer-songwriter 9Lana performs the ending theme song "Rasen" (Spiral).

Viz Media and Fathom Entertainment screened in advance Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity 's first three episodes in U.S. theaters on June 25-29.

title: Comikey Adds Mato Kauta's The Wolf King's Bride Manga
content:
Comikey announced on Friday it has licensed Mato Kauta 's The Wolf King’s Bride ( Ōkami-Heika no Hanayome ) manga. The company released the first five chapters digitally, and will add new chapters every Friday.

Comikey describes the story:

"If you leak this matter out to anyone, even by accident..." Yurin, the daughter of a low-level official, came into the royal palace after hearing about an amazing job with high pay. Unfortunately for her, that work entailed playing the role of a bride for the cold and ruthless Wolf King, Haku Reisho. After starting her work within the rear palace that's rife with conspiracy, Yurin learned of His Majesty's secret. What will become of her fate?!

Comikey had announced in August it will release several shōjo manga titles from Hakusensha 's catalogue in English digitally, and teased an image that had featured the manga.

Kauta serialized the manga in Hakusensha 's LaLa magazine from 2009 to 2018, and the manga has 19 volumes. The manga has not previously had an English release.

Other new manga Comikey has released or will release in October includes:

• Soukai Studio's How I Became the Duke's Beloved Daughter webtoon (October 7)

• Nozomu Amaike and Kenichi Kisaragi's Local Farmer Kills Dragon, Outs Himself as The Strongest in the Land! manga (October 12)

• Kizu Kanoda, Yukiko Tadano, and Shisseki's At Home with a Girl in Her Cute Pajamas manga (October 14)

• Tomoki Matsumoto and LOSA's The Bound Hero Knows No Fear manga (October 19)

• Inariyama's My Faceless Classmate, Wakao manga (October 21)

• Punichan and Maro Yanagiya's I'm the Demon Lord, but For Some Reason the Hero's Infatuated With Me manga (October 26)

• taskey's The Black-Winged Emperor Adores the Shunned Saint in the Tower webtoon (October 28)

• Bodax, Kaoruho Hananami, and Jio Miyata's I'm Marrying the Pauper Count of a Remote Frontier, So I'll Work Hard to Reform his Territory ～The Letter From Boule～ manga (October 30)

title: Peow2 Licenses Jyoshikohei, Alien 9, Phantom Core Manga
content:
Sweden-based comic publisher Peow2 announced on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday it has licensed three new manga for English release: Jiro Matsumoto 's Jyoshikohei , Hitoshi Tomizawa 's Alien 9 , and Yasushi Nirasawa 's Phantom Core .

‼️INCOMING LICENSE💥 Jyoshikohei by Jiro Matsumoto . Giant high school girl mechs rule the dimensional battlefield, but they drive their middle-aged male pilots insane. Takigawa's job? Brutally hunt down the ones that go rogue. Coming 2027, 3 new omnibus editions from Peow2 [image or embed] — Peow2 ( @peow.bsky.social ) October 14, 2026 at 1:53 AM

Matsumoto launched Jyoshikohei in 2011. Shinchosha published the seventh and final volume in December 2015. Peow2 describes the story:

Giant high school girl mechs rule the dimensional battlefield, but they drive their middle-aged male pilots insane. Takigawa's job? Brutally hunt down the ones that go rogue.

The company will release the manga in an omnibus format in three volumes starting in 2027. The first volume will feature an A3-size poster with new artwork from Matsumoto.

Vertical published Matsumoto's Velveteen & Mandala manga in English, and Kodama Tales has licensed Matsumoto's beautiful place manga.

🪲INCOMING LICENSE‼️ Alien 9 -The Complete- by Hitoshi Tomizawa Grimcute sci-fi?! A grade school Alien Defense Force risks their lives on a daily basis to dispatch aliens that are constantly trying to invade their school. It's sticky, slimy, scary work, but somebody has gotta do it. Coming 2027 [image or embed] — Peow2 ( @peow.bsky.social ) October 15, 2026 at 12:35 AM

Peow2 will release the Alien 9 manga in 2027, and it describes the story:

Grimcute sci-fi?! A grade school Alien Defense Force risks their lives on a daily basis to dispatch aliens that are constantly trying to invade their school. It's sticky, slimy, scary work, but somebody has gotta do it.

Central Park Media previously released part of the manga in English in 2003. The manga ran from 1998 to 1999 and Akita Shoten published three volumes.

The manga inspired a four-episode OVA that debuted in May 2001. Central Park Media previously released the series in North America, and AnimEigo re-released the series on Blu-ray Disc on June 9.

Peow2 will release Phantom Core in spring 2027 and it describes the story:

Monster lovers rejoice!!! The companion sci-fi/fantasy manga to our upcoming release CREATURE CORE. Follow Phancure, the beer loving freelance suppressor and Nina Dolono hunt down demented WEPTURES!

Hobby Japan originally serialized the manga in Hobby Japan Extra magazine

Peow2 is also releasing Nirasawa's Creature Core collection of works and artbook in English.

Nirasawa is known for his design and modeling work on television series and films such as Garo , Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within , and several Heisei-era Kamen Rider series.

Nirasawa died in 2016 at the age of 52 from kidney failure.

title: 3 Fantasy Webtoon That Should Get Anime Instead of The Remarried Empress
content:
The webtoon industry is on the rise thanks to several anime adaptations, and Crunchyroll has played a huge role in giving these anime a global platform. One of the biggest projects is The Remarried Empress , a controversial romance fantasy. The series was first released as a manhwa and light novel around the same month in 2019 before getting an English release. While the manhwa and light novel have already ended, fans have something new to look forward to next year with the anime premiere . However, the series is hated for poorly handling sensitive themes, especially with the way it villainizes a young slave girl who later became the Emperor’s concubine.

The story glosses over the issues of slavery while treating them as inferior to ordinary citizens. Despite having love for her kingdom and its people, the Empress never cared for the slaves and purposely ignored their suffering due to their lower status. While the story stays true to its themes, considering how the royalty will be blind to the suffering of the less privileged and even look down on them, many readers criticize the thoughtless portrayal of such themes. Regardless of how you look at it, the series is hated for all the right reasons. This is why these three romance fantasy webtoons deserve an anime adaptation much more than The Remarried Empress .

3) The Fantasie of a Stepmother

Whether it’s the cinematic art style, the emotional depth, or the realistic character development, this webtoon deserves a lot more popularity than it already has. The story follows Shuri, a young widow who was left to manage her late husband’s vast fortune and his four children. Despite being young and having no experience managing the household, she does her best to raise them even though the boys never hid their hostility towards her. Shuri is finally free from her responsibilities when her eldest stepson remarries. However, she never expected time would reset to seven years in the past. It was the night of her husband’s funeral that life took a drastic turn. As the story continues, she takes a different path, hoping to set things right and even find her own happiness along the way. The series has been ongoing since 2021, and it has shown one of the best plotlines in the webtoon industry.

2) I Married the Male Lead’s Dad

You can rarely go wrong with the found family trope, but this historical fantasy is a tad different from the usual transmigration tropes. The story follows a young girl who woke up as Aisha Heathcliff in the same world as Abel Louveremont, the main character of her favorite novel. As Abel’s fangirl, she wants nothing more than to meet her favorite character, who is currently a young child. However, one thing leads to another, and before she can realize it, she somehow gets engaged to his dad. The story begins with a common plot, but it later unravels the truth behind her transmigration and the connection she had with Abel and his father. The story is often emotional as it focuses on tragic backstories, well-written characters, and the curse that shackles Aisha. The main story has already reached its conclusion, while the manhwa is currently focusing on the side stories where Abel is a teenager.

1) How to Win My Husband Over

This gorgeous story follows yet another unique transmigration plot thanks to its exceptional writing while also handling sensitive themes of trauma. The story centers around a young woman who died in an airplane crash while thinking she would finally escape her hellish life. However, when she woke up as Rudbeckia de Borgia, a minor villain from a novel, she realized she had fallen into another nightmare. After being tortured by her current family, what awaits her is dying at the hands of her husband, Iske van Omerta. However, instead of giving in to fate, Ruby does everything she can to seem harmless and get her husband on her side. The story portrays Ruby’s PTSD, anxiety, and eating disorders as a consequence of the abuse she suffered. Instead of using her trauma as a plot device, these themes drive the narrative. The series was first released as a manhwa and light novel around the same month in 2019 before getting an English release. The story glosses over the issues of slavery while treating them as inferior to ordinary citizens. Despite having love for her kingdom and its people, the Empress never cared for the slaves and purposely ignored their suffering due to their lower status. The story follows Shuri, a young widow who was left to manage her late husband’s vast fortune and his four children. Despite being young and having no experience managing the household, she does her best to raise them even though the boys never hid their hostility towards her. Shuri is finally free from her responsibilities when her eldest stepson remarries. However, she never expected time would reset to seven years in the past. It was the night of her husband’s funeral that life took a drastic turn. As the story continues, she takes a different path, hoping to set things right and even find her own happiness along the way. The series has been ongoing since 2021, and it has shown one of the best plotlines in the webtoon industry.

title: Viz Media Licenses Jojolion, His Sweet Solace, Under Doctor, More Manga for Summer 2027
content:
Viz Media revealed on its X (formerly Twitter ) account on Friday its slate of works it will release in summer 2027:

Viz Media will release a complete box set collection of Julietta Suzuki 's Kamisama Kiss manga with 25 volumes. The collection will include a double-sided poster and a mini artbook.

Viz Media will release Yukinobu Tatsu 's Dandadan : The Official Character Guide book. The book includes character profiles, trivia, plot summaries, and a bonus manga.

Viz Media will release Hideo Kojima 's The Gifted Gene: 70% of My Body is Made of Movies hardcover novel. The novel is a follow-up to The Creative Gene .

The company will release Ei Yamano 's Someone Hertz manga. Viz Media describes the manga:

A straitlaced overachiever and a hilarious slacker girl are united by their love of submitting entries to a joke competition on a late-night comedy radio show. As the competition heats up, so do their hearts!

Viz Media will release Kyō Tanimoto 's Under Doctor manga. The company describes the story:

From death dealer to deft healer, this assassin becomes a doctor! Born into an assassin family, Haiji Kino uses his deadly power to save lives as a travelling doctor. But a new life is no clean slate.

Viz Media will release Jujutsu Kaisen : The Official Coloring Book , featuring 80 pages of Gege Akutami 's manga art.

Viz Media will release Mariana's Diabo a Quatro comic. The company describes the story:

When rival witch apprentices Sandro and Rafael accidentally awaken the Great Conqueror Witch Guiomar, they must go on an unlikely quest to undo Guiomar's curse, before her past catches up with them all.

The publisher will release Rose Takada 's His Sweet Solace manga. The company describes the story:

Aoba's writing career is stalling. When her editor suggests writing about sex services for women, curiosity and loneliness lead her to a world where the boundaries between love and work blur.

Viz Media will release Ru1mm's Belladona's Lover yuri manga. The company describes the story:

Belladonna's Lover follows cursed forest witch Bella, struggling artist Anna, and their journey to break Bella's curse with true love's kiss. Volume also includes two more fairy tale–inspired yuri romances.

Viz Media will release an all-in-one edition of the Howl's Moving Castle film comic.

Viz Media will release Wishroomness and Keon Tan's Astray comic. The publisher describes the story:

When an alien mercenary kidnaps Uni's cat, they are accidentally stranded in a distant galaxy. Without enough money to get home, Uni takes on galactic gigs with the secretive mercenary.

The company will release Sakane Toyobayashi's Bus for Two manga, and it describes the story:

Childhood friends Shunpei and An haven't spoken in years, despite sharing the same bus ride every day. Could a little awkward banter bring them back together, and even spark something more?

Lastly, Viz Media announced it will release Hirohiko Araki 's JoJolion manga in a deluxe hardcover edition with color pages. The company describes the story:

Return to Morioh for a bizarre new mystery! Set in the same alternate universe as Steel Ball Run , JoJo's Bizarre Adventure : Part 8— JoJolion , Vol. 1 by Hirohiko Araki arrives Summer 2027 in a deluxe hardcover edition with color pages!

title: Haikyu Creator Returns With New Look at Shoyo Ahead of New Movie
content:
While fans await the upcoming anime movie, Haruichi Furudate drops a new look at Shoyo Hinata to commemorate the first Haruko collaboration since 2020. The series is Japan’s Spring High Volleyball tournament for the first time in seven years. As it’s a big deal, the creator shares a stunning new look at Hinata, which was shared by the official X handle of the manga . When it comes to sports anime, no modern series can come close to the influence and popularity of Haikyu!! The manga began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2012 and reached its conclusion in 2020.

However, although it’s been more than six years since the manga reached its conclusion, the anime is far from adapting the entire story. Season 4 was released in two parts in 2020, following which a sequel film titled Haikyu!! The Dumpster Battle premiered in 2024 to feature the most anticipated match in the series. A year after its premiere, Haikyu!! vs. The Little Giant was officially confirmed, and now that the release date is known, fans might get new updates on the anime. While the wait has been longer than expected, the anime will be more than exciting with stunning visuals and one of the most intense matches in the series.

Does Haikyu!! vs. The Little Giant Movie Have a Release Date?

As of now, the movie has not locked down an exact release date, but it will be out in 2027 . So far, not much is known about the movie, including a final trailer and streaming updates. The release date will be first revealed for Japanese theatres, as it usually takes a while before the international release. While the wait seems longer, the movie will be sharing new information sooner than expected. Shueisha is holding its annual Jump Festa on December 19th and 20th, 2026. It’s the largest convention for anime and manga fans held annually by the company to reveal the latest updates on Shonen Jump series. Each year, fans get major updates on their favorite shows and manga, including new anime announcements and more. Haikyu will be holding a panel during the Super Stage, where we can expect the anime to drop a release window and even a teaser.

Is Haikyu!! vs. The Little Giant the Final Movie?

Although Haikyu!! vs. The Little Giant is promoted as the final movie, we might get a Season 5 after it. The upcoming movie will wrap up the Spring High National Tournament, but the story still has to adapt the final arc . It centers around Shoyo Hinata several years after he graduated from high school and continues his volleyball journey. Hinata also reunites with several of his high school friends and rivals on the court as they all become professional volleyball players.

The final arc is only 32 chapters long, which could mean that a season of around 11-12 episodes or another feature-length film could be adapted in the future. However, the anime won’t be sharing any updates on the final arc before the match against Kamomedai. Considering the popularity of the franchise, we can expect the entire manga to be adapted into an anime, even if it might take a few years. Unlike most Shonen Jump series, Haikyu!! is known for having one of the best final arcs of all time, which is all the more reason the series deserves a sequel after the match against Kamomedai.
